payload.text: let people photograph a handwritten recipe card instead of typing it in
freshness check: OCR-from-photo APIs are commodity now, not a differentiator to build in-house
tag recipes by "who gave it to you" instead of by cuisine
ship family-provenance tagging as the v1 differentiator

categories.title: Framing & Reframing
categories.description: Techniques that change the sentence describing the problem before any solution gets generated.

categories.title: Narrowing
categories.description: Convergent techniques that reduce a generated idea set down to a committed short list.

techniques.name: Question Ladder
techniques.mechanics: Restate the problem as five different questions in a row, each climbing to a broader or narrower altitude than the last, then ideate against whichever rewrite feels least like the original.

techniques.name: Verb Swap
techniques.mechanics: Swap the single core verb in your goal statement for ten unrelated verbs in a row, generating exactly one idea for each swap before moving to the next.

techniques.name: Frame Flip
techniques.mechanics: Restate the goal as its exact opposite (a 'prevent X' goal becomes 'cause X'), generate freely inside that inverted frame, then translate every result back to the original.

techniques.name: Cluster & Name
techniques.mechanics: Group the raw idea list into affinity clusters by underlying theme, name each cluster in three words, then pick the strongest representative from each cluster.
